waivers.verdict: Claim Anthony Richardson for $23 into the spot the Bowers trade opened. With Young gone, Goff and Cousins are your only healthy quarterbacks until Lamar returns. $23 is $1 more than GehrmannJake's entire budget, and they're the team most likely to want him.

lineup.verdict: Start Kirk Cousins at SUPER_FLEX before tonight's 8:20pm ET Vikings-49ers kickoff — that slot is empty right now and costs about 20 points sitting that way. Bowers being ruled out for today's game changes nothing else.

trades.verdict: Hold. This afternoon's Bowers-for-Young-and-Kraft trade already closed the one real hole on the roster; a fresh scan of all 11 other teams finds nothing else Ben would be certain to be better off making, with today being the last day trades process this season.

inactives.verdict: Brock Bowers is officially out for today's Raiders-Broncos game. He's bench depth, not a starter, so nothing in the active lineup changes. The open item is still the empty SUPER_FLEX from this afternoon's trade — that's on the lineup report, not an inactive.
